safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state that the patient has no prior history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute post-sting presentation with reported breathing difficulty and possible lip swelling, documenting a negative history of anaphylaxis helps risk-stratify and guide urgency and follow-up planning. Omitting it may lead subsequent clinicians to treat the history as unknown, potentially prompting unnecessary escalation or redundant evaluation.
